New York: Christie's will offer an 8.17-carat diamond ring without reserve, estimated at up to $350,000, in an online sale running through 15 October.

The D-color, internally flawless stone leads more than 260 lots in Christie's Jewels Online sale, alongside pieces from Bulgari, Cartier and Harry Winston. The next-highest estimate, a 7.85-carat Graff ring, tops out at $280,000.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
